main_text.l: At ὧν ἄδυ, apud inferos: subaudi-
tur πότμῳ, loco: ut Latiné ad Opis, sup-
ple ædem. Sic ὧν διδασκάλου, in docto-
ris: supple οἴκῳ, domo: quod frequens
thius. Poeticé ὧνì & εἰν pro ὧν.
Cum articulo est pro nomine, ὁ ὧν
τῖς ἐγχοῖς, cœlestis, vel qui est in cœlis:
Θεῷ, Dei auxilio: Aliquando subauditur, ἀποτεμὼν αὐτὰς
ὠλέναις τὰ πτερά, amputans ipsisulnis pennas, id est, cum ipsis

page.notes: Greek text and accents reproduced as far as legible; some Greek words in the scan are blurred and may contain errors. Catchword-like mark "C" at foot is a signature. Marginal numeral "3" at right of the Poeticé paragraph is a small mark, placed as a footnote.
